name: The Siren Bay Chronicles: Shattered Dreams
source:
It's 2042 and you live in a lawless city of Siren Bay, where violent crime, murders and ruthless corporations rule. As a former police officer all you want is peace and quiet. Everything changes when one day a former colleague from the police force visits you and asks for your help to investigate a brutal murder of her childhood friend. You have bad feelings about this but you know you can't refuse. If you only knew how lethal it can be...

[From F95Zone]
translation:
2042年，你生活在无法无天的塞壬湾。暴力犯罪、谋杀与冷酷无情的企业统治着这座城市。身为前警察，你只想过安静的生活。某天，一位过去的警界同事找上门，请你帮忙调查她青梅竹马惨遭杀害的案件，一切就此改变。你有种不祥的预感，却也知道，自己无法拒绝。若你能预见这件事会有多么致命……

[摘自F95Zone]
